engine: Claude packet-build lane in an isolated git worktree, executing the FABLE-PD brief

laneGate.note: npm ci was run first: pdf_lib_importable failed on a checkout with no node_modules, which is an environment state rather than a lane finding.

laneNotes: Five families assigned, five rows returned, all five stopped at the claim gate before anything was read.
Every one refuses with ALREADY_RELEASED. The grants are held by PF14 and marked released; the ledger's releases[] log records lane PF04 as the releaser, within a 0.3-second window on 2026-09-01.
None of the five has an overlay directory and none appears in any lane's rows.json, so five families were released without being built. That is a finding for whoever owns the dispatch and the ledger.
This lane wrote nothing for any of them and did not reopen a single grant.
grantsNothing: A built family is a built family. It is not verified, not approved, not sellable, and this lane issues no verdict on its own packets.

focusedCheck.result: not run: no family in this lane was claimed, so none was read or built

rows.why: The grant for this family is held by PF14 and is already marked released. The claim gate refuses the assert, and a refused assert is a full stop: nothing of this family was read and nothing was written.
rows.whatTheLedgerShows: claim-ledger.json records the grant with lane PF14, laneKind packet-build, released true. The matching entry in the ledger's releases[] array records the release as made by lane PF04, not PF14. All five of this lane's PF14 families show the same shape and the same five release timestamps within 0.3 seconds of each other.
rows.whatThatProbablyMeans: The dispatch regenerates and these five families appear to have moved from PF04 to PF14 between generations, carrying the released flag forward while the append-only releases[] log kept the lane that actually released them. Reported rather than diagnosed: this lane does not own the ledger.
rows.noBuildProductExists: None of the five has an overlay directory at the path ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS gives it, and no rows.json in the factory records any of them. Whatever released them, nothing was built.
rows.grantNotTransferred: claim.mjs offers a --reopen path. This lane did not use it. A refused assert is a full stop and a lane does not transfer a grant to itself.
